candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the failing dependency, not the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side telemetry (logs, traces, DB/Redis metrics) is absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 is not established; only the propagation path is bounded.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway /v1/checkout 502s paired with order POST /v1/orders 500s in the same correlation IDs, and topology confirms gateway->order. This bounds the failure to the order dependency returning 500. Order-internal cause (pool, Redis, payment, config) is not observable from current evidence, so only the http-500 propagation candidate is asserted.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders showing the internal error and stack
Order service DB pool metrics (acquisition wait, active/idle connections) to test db-pool-exhaustion
Inventory/Redis latency and timeout metrics to test redis-timeout
Payment downstream latency metrics to test downstream-latency
